Bash(git commit -m "Fix theme switcher by removing admin_dark.css from main application layout

## Problem
Theme toggle button changed icon but didn''t actually switch colors.

## Root Cause
admin_dark.css was being loaded on ALL pages (via application.html.erb),
and it has hardcoded dark colors that override the CSS variables:
- $admin-bg-primary: #0A0E1A (always dark)
- $admin-text-primary: #FFFFFF (always light text)

These hardcoded colors prevented themes.scss CSS variables from working.

## Solution
Removed admin_dark.css import from application.html.erb.

Admin pages still get admin_dark.css via admin.html.erb (line 10).
Main application pages now only use themes.scss with proper CSS variable-based
theme switching.

## Result
✅ Theme switcher now works correctly
✅ Clicking moon/sun button switches between light and dark themes
✅ Colors transition smoothly via CSS variables
✅ Admin pages unaffected (still have admin_dark.css)
✅ Preference persists in localStorage

Users can now toggle between light and dark themes seamlessly!")
